title: Initial restricted-vector norm bound
statement: Let $n$ be a positive integer, let $A$ be any real $n\times n$ matrix, and let $B\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$ have size at most $\beta n$, where $\beta\ge0$. Define $r_0$ to have entry $1/n$ on $B$ and $0$ elsewhere. Then $\|r_0\|\le\sqrt{\beta}/\sqrt{n}$.
